Class ECEngine

java.lang.Object
org.iam.core.ECEngine
@ParametersAreNonnullByDefault public class ECEngine extends Object
The equivalence class (EC) engine of a domain, built on Delta-net's atom-splitting approach.

The partitioning and the incremental update that lets a later mining task reuse it (Technique 1) both live in IncrementalECPartition; this class is the entry point the rest of the code base holds on to. A caller that only needs a one-shot partition — the intent reducer, for instance — builds the engine and reads getECs() back off it, while a caller that drives successive mining tasks reaches the partitioning through IncrementalECPartition.update(Set).

Since:
2025-02-28
